item.title: 'Canada's warmest saltwater beach' has 1 km of soft sand and rolling dunes
item.description: It might not be time for beach vacations just yet, but if you need to daydream about warmer days ahead, look no further than Canada's warmest saltwater beach. Tucked away alongside a cute small town, this beach has velvety sand, scenic views, and warm water to dive into. Parlee Beach is in New Brunswick, near the charming small town of Shediac, and is famous for having toasty warm water.
